verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance/GRC platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Vanta-hosted infrastructure, such as regional Vanta-hosted MCP servers and a Vanta Gov (FedRAMP) API endpoint, and nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. Private integrations for on-prem systems are an adjacent feature for pushing data into Vanta's cloud, not self-hosting.
